timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.74 today, down 29 cents from a month ago and up $1.03 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.58. Cheaper than last month, still ouch.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, November 13, in 7 days. Time to fill that tag.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, November 14, in 8 days, and runs through November 24. Time to sight in that rifle.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season opens again Wednesday, November 25, in 19 days, and runs through January 15. Round two is coming.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, November 27, in 21 days, and runs through November 29. Get the kids ready.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Dove season ends Sunday, November 29, in 23 days. Last call for dove hunters.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, November 11, in 5 days. Take a moment to thank a veteran.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, in 20 days. Start stretching those stretchy pants.

timely.label: Black Friday
timely.line: Black Friday is Friday, November 27, in 21 days. Start hiding the credit card.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The Cat in the Hat, an animated movie with Bill Hader as the Cat, opened in theaters Nov. 6. Hope the kids don't copy the mess.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Meat Loaf scored his first No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 with 'I'd Do Anything for Love (But I Won't Do That)' in 1993. We still don't know what 'that' is.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Hall & Oates began a two-week run at No. 1 with 'Private Eyes' in 1981. Still stuck in your head, isn't it?

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Pentatonix became the first a cappella group with a No. 1 US album in 2015. No instruments needed.

timely.label: Fun Fact
timely.line: The Pillsbury Doughboy debuted in TV commercials in 1965. Still giggling after all these years.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Led Zeppelin released its fourth album, with 'Stairway to Heaven,' in 1971. That's 55 years of air guitar.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: Disney's animated 'Robin Hood' premiered in 1973, with animal characters including Little John and Maid Marian. A fine family movie night idea.

timely.label: Streaming
timely.line: Jessica Chastain plays a former country music legend searching for her missing niece in the Netflix crime thriller 'Heartland,' out Nov. 13. Set Friday night aside.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting a mentored rabbit hunt Dec. 12 in Dent County for first-time hunters ages 18 to 34. Rabbit stew, anyone?

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation added four Share the Harvest deer drop-off sites in Carroll, Macon, Putnam and Randolph counties, open 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily. Donating venison just got easier.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Field & Stream calls Sunday, Nov. 8, the fourth best day of the rut, when the chasing phase breaks wide open. Sunday sermon: get in the stand.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Arlopu is recalling slide playsets because a child's torso can fit through openings a head can't, creating a head and neck entrapment risk. Worth a quick look in the backyard.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Jiastfeng is recalling HAUOMS eight-drawer dressers that can tip over if they aren't anchored to the wall. Anchor those dressers, folks.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Kikea Store is recalling X-VESOLJE nursing pillows because they can block an infant's breathing. Check the nursery.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Baby Brezza is recalling its SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers because they can overheat and burn skin. Check the kitchen counter.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says car-shopping dads should embrace the minivan, which handles carpool, the dog, the stroller, groceries and plywood sheets. Not cool, but it hauls.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's crispy lemon pepper wings are made in the air fryer with lemon pepper, garlic, lemon zest and parsley. Game day, minus the fryer mess.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn rounded up 15 dump-and-bake dinners for busy weeknights when you can't put in much effort. Dump, bake, done.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn has an Instant Pot mac and cheese that skips the roux. Fewer pans, more cheese.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Best Buy has sales running all the way to Christmas. Your wallet can breathe.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Sony is reaching out to some customers offering up to $400 for their PS5. Check your email before eBay.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Starbucks released its first holiday-themed Pup Cup, a 3.5-ounce whipped cream treat with a beagle design, sold in stores while supplies last. Fido's turn at the drive-through.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster asks how to keep Christmas meaningful when the adults don't need anything and the kids already have enough toys. Gift cards again?
